label.description: What kind of thing it is, such as NAME or DATE.

raw_value.description: The thing as it was said.

start_word.description: Position of its first word in the transcript.

value.description: The thing as written in the transcript.

formatted_transcript.description: The transcript laid out in paragraphs, with 'Speaker 0:' labels when speakers are identified. The same as the transcript unless paragraphs are on.

intent_segments.description: Which intents were found in which passage, with confidence scores.

end_word.description: Position of the passage's last word.

intents.description: The intents found in this passage.

confidence_score.description: How sure Deepgram is, from 0 to 1.

start_word.description: Position of the passage's first word.

intents.description: The distinct intents found anywhere in it.

language_confidence.description: How sure Deepgram is of the detected language, from 0 to 1.

languages.description: Every language heard, most words first, when several languages are allowed.

metadata.description: Deepgram's own record of the request: its models, the recording's checksum, and the tokens any analysis used.

paragraphs.description: Each paragraph, when paragraphs are on.

channel.description: The channel it was said on, from 0.

speaker.description: The speaker's number, from 0, when speakers are identified.

request_id.description: Deepgram's ID for this request, to look it up with 'Get request' or quote to their support.

sentiment.description: The overall sentiment: 'positive', 'neutral' or 'negative'. Only when sentiment was asked for.

sentiment_score.description: The overall sentiment as a number from -1 (negative) to 1 (positive).

sentiment_segments.description: The sentiment of each passage, in order.

end_word.description: Position of the passage's last word.

start_word.description: Position of the passage's first word.

speaker_count.description: How many different speakers were heard; 0 unless speakers are identified.

summary.description: A short summary of the recording. Only when a summary was asked for.

topic_segments.description: Which topics were found in which passage, with confidence scores.

end_word.description: Position of the passage's last word.

start_word.description: Position of the passage's first word.

topics.description: The topics found in this passage.

confidence_score.description: How sure Deepgram is, from 0 to 1.

topics.description: The distinct topics found anywhere in it.

transcript.description: Everything said, as plain text. With several channels, each channel's text in turn, separated by a blank line.

utterances.description: Each stretch of speech between pauses, when utterances are on.

channel.description: The channel it was said on, from 0.

confidence.description: How sure Deepgram is, from 0 to 1.

languages.description: The languages heard in it, when several are allowed.

speaker.description: The speaker's number, from 0, when speakers are identified.

warnings.description: What Deepgram couldn't do, such as summarizing a language it doesn't summarize, while still transcribing.

parameter.description: The option the warning is about.

words.description: Every word, in order, with when it was said.

channel.description: The channel the word was said on, from 0.

confidence.description: How sure Deepgram is of the word, from 0 to 1.

end.description: When the word ends, in seconds.

language.description: The word's language, when several are allowed.

punctuated_word.description: The word with punctuation and capitals, when they are on.

speaker.description: The speaker's number, from 0, when speakers are identified.

speaker_confidence.description: How sure Deepgram is of the speaker, from 0 to 1.

start.description: When the word starts, in seconds from the beginning.

word.description: The word as heard, in lower case.

description: Transcribe calls, meetings and videos with Deepgram, with speakers, summaries and redaction; turn text into lifelike speech saved as an audio file; analyze text for its summary, sentiment, topics and intents; and keep an eye on the account's balance, usage and costs.
